The '''1947–48 Danish 1st Division''' season was the 3rd edition of [[Danish 1st Division]] annual [[Association football|football]] competition in Denmark. It was contested by 10 teams.

[[Akademisk Boldklub]] unsuccessfully defended its [[1945-46 Danish 1st Division|1946 title]]. [[Kjøbenhavns Boldklub]] successfully pursued its 1947 title.

Statistics of [[Danish 1st Division]] in the 1947/1948 season.
